document.title: perf(render): cut native draw time on rounded rects, text lines and batching
document.summary: Three independent cuts to the UI thread's draw span: rounded rect fills skip trigonometry, a Text's lines are broken once by layout instead of every frame, and shapes sample the glyph atlas so rlgl batches them with text. The Vita3K baseline is re-recorded.
document.why: On the Vita the UI thread spends most of each frame drawing, even when nothing changes, so richer Deck Apps will start dropping frames [#126](source:s1).

sources.title: perf(render): native drawing takes half the UI thread on the Vita
sources.gist: Draw takes 6-10 ms of the 16.7 ms frame on the device; profile by element type and make draw mean and UI thread CPU drop in every scenario.

sources.label: PR #130
sources.gist: A Vita3K profile located the cost in rounded Button fills, per-frame text_lines and texture-switch draw calls; draw mean drops 51-74% in Vita3K.

lookFor: The issue's Verify step asks for `scripts/bench.sh vita` with UI thread CPU % on the device [#126](source:s1); the PR measures only Vita3K, which has no CPU %, and leaves the Vita baseline untouched [PR #130](source:s2).
The issue proposes skipping or reusing unchanged frames [#126](source:s1); the PR does not, and cuts per-frame cost instead.

groups.title: Rounded rect fills without trig
groups.why: The profile put 1.5 ms of minesweeper-idle's 1.85 ms draw span in raylib's DrawRectangleRounded, which calls sinf and cosf 96 times per rect [PR #130](source:s2).
groups.summary: `draw_rounded_rect` in `render.c` replays raylib 5.5's quad path from a corner-direction table built once per segment count, and the four rounded fill call sites switch to it.
lookFor: Subtle: the copy is pinned to raylib 5.5's `SUPPORT_QUADS_DRAW_MODE` path; odd or sub-4 segment counts fall back to raylib, and a raylib bump needs a re-check that the vertices still match.

groups.title: Text lines kept from layout
groups.why: Render re-joined, re-wrapped and re-measured every Text every frame, 1.1-1.6 ms of demo-text's and demo-scroll's draw span [PR #130](source:s2).
groups.summary: `layout_tree` takes the front snapshot's arena and keeps each Text's lines as a `TextLayout` in `InstanceLayout.text`, which `render_text_instance` draws instead of calling `text_lines`.
lookFor: Subtle: the kept lines live in the snapshot arena, which the JS thread frees after a swap; render reads them only under `snapshot_mutex`, and fonts reload only after `instance_tree_clear`, so a drawn Text never outlives its lines or font.

groups.title: Shapes batch with text through the glyph atlas
groups.why: Shapes sampled raylib's default font texture and text the glyph atlas, so rlgl opened a new draw call at nearly every switch: 113 a frame in demo-scroll [PR #130](source:s2).
groups.summary: Every atlas page in `glyph_cache.c` starts with an opaque white square, and `text_upload_pages` points raylib's shapes texture at page 0's, restoring raylib's in `text_reset` before the pages unload.
lookFor: Perf: the Shell draws labels with raylib's `DrawText`, so once a Deck App creates page 0 the Shell's shapes and labels switch textures, a few dozen extra draw calls while it is open.
Subtle: `GLYPH_SIZE_MAX` is 1019, so a glyph or emoji 1020-1024 px wide no longer fits a page.

commits.subject: test(bench): record the Vita3K baseline after the drawing changes
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: docs(render): text_lines is broken once by layout, which keeps the copy render draws
commits.author: Máté Molnár

commits.subject: perf(render): draw a Text's lines from layout instead of breaking them every frame
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Layout breaks every Text into lines once per snapshot, then render broke each one again every frame: joining its raw text, wrapping and measuring. Layout now keeps the lines in the snapshot arena and render draws them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: perf(render): fill rounded rects from precomputed corner directions
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
DrawRectangleRounded calls sinf and cosf 96 times per rect at 8 segments, so a screen of 145 rounded Buttons spent most of its draw time on trigonometry. The same quads now come from a table computed once per segment count.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: perf(render): draw shapes from the glyph atlas so they batch with text
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Shapes drew from raylib's default font texture and text from the glyph atlas, so rlgl started a new draw call at almost every Button and Text. Every atlas page now starts with an opaque white square, and raylib's shapes texture points at page 0's.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
